item.title: SCARY ENCOUNTERS with MONSTERS and LEGENDS! (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Christian MacLeod, known as The Cryptid Guy, is the Director and Lead Investigator of the American Cryptid and Paranormal Society (A.C.A.P.S.), bringing more than 25 years of experience investigating cryptids, paranormal activity, and unexplained phenomena. His research explores everything from Bigfoot and mysterious creatures to UFOs, the occult, forbidden archaeology, secret societies, and alleged government cover-ups. With a strong interest in Native American history, folklore, and legends, Christian combines historical research with field investigations to explore mysteries that continue to challenge conventional explanations. His academic background includes studies in psychology, criminology, education, and American history.

Through A.C.A.P.S., Christian has worked alongside renowned paranormal researcher Joshua P. Warren on investigations and expeditions examining unusual phenomena. Their collaborative research has included explorations of reported hidden tunnel systems beneath Asheville, North Carolina, along with investigations into historical mysteries and unexplained activity. Christian's approach blends investigative experience, historical knowledge, and a passion for uncovering the truth behind extraordinary claims. Whether tracking legendary cryptids, examining paranormal encounters, or exploring the secrets of ancient civilizations, Christian continues his pursuit of answers to some of the world's most fascinating mysteries.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
